title:
Implement 5 onboarding UX improvements to the crosslink CLI from https://github.com/forecast-bio/crosslink/issues/365.

The crosslink source is not checked out locally. Clone https://github.com/forecast-bio/crosslink to a working directory first, then implement:

1. **SSH key fingerprint** (agent.rs): Move SSH key output behind --verbose flag in status(), init(), and bootstrap() (~4 locations in src/commands/agent.rs)

2. **Orientation after init/session start**: Add a short explanation of what crosslink tracks and the minimal workflow after crosslink init and crosslink session start output

3. **Label multi-agent features**: In help text for --container, agent SSH/lock commands, add a note like '[multi-agent]' to signal these are optional for solo use

4. **Lock display context**: In agent status output, add a one-line explanation of what a lock is when locks are shown (e.g. 'Locks: #2, #3 (issues this agent is working on)')

5. **Richer session status**: Add counts of actions recorded, comments added to the session status output

Reference the upstream issue for full context. Create a PR on the crosslink repo with all changes.
